site.audience: general consumers looking for streaming entertainment

brief.title: StreamWave — Unlimited Films, Series and More
brief.one_liner: A premium streaming platform offering unlimited access to films, series, anime, documentaries and more on any device.
brief.goal: Convert visitors into subscribers by showcasing content variety, platform benefits, and providing a frictionless sign-up flow with email capture.

pages.objective: Attract new subscribers with a compelling hero section, showcase trending content, highlight platform benefits, answer common questions, and capture email for sign-up.
Allow existing users to sign in with email/mobile and password, or direct new users to create an account.

interactions.trigger: Click on a FAQ question item
interactions.expected: The clicked question expands to reveal its answer, other open items collapse

interactions.trigger: Enter email in hero section and click Get Started
interactions.expected: Email field accepts input and Get Started button is clickable

interactions.trigger: Enter email in bottom CTA section and click Get Started
interactions.expected: Email field accepts input and Get Started button is clickable

interactions.trigger: Click next arrow on trending content row
interactions.expected: Carousel scrolls to reveal more trending titles

interactions.trigger: Enter email/mobile and password then click Continue
interactions.expected: Form validates input fields and submits login credentials

interactions.trigger: Click Get help link below login form

data_display.description: Numbered list of top 10 trending shows displayed as a horizontal carousel with rank numbers

expected_content: Download your series to watch offline
data_display.description: Four feature cards highlighting key platform benefits with titles and descriptions

expected_content: What can I watch on StreamWave?
data_display.description: Six expandable FAQ items covering common subscriber questions
Starting price displayed in hero section below main heading
Grid of footer navigation links for support and corporate information
